prompt:
Develop a robust, full-featured web-based writing platform designed specifically as an alternative to LivingWriter, catering to authors, screenwriters, and long-form document creators.
Key Features to Include:
1. Tech Stack: Use React with TailwindCSS for a highly polished, responsive interface, a Node.js backend with SQLite (or PostgreSQL) for local-first data storage with an option for cloud synchronization.
2. Story Outlines & Templates: Pre-load the application with popular storytelling structural templates (e.g., 27 Chapter Method, 3 Act Structure, Hero's Journey, Save the Cat). Allow users to view these templates in a sidebar for easy reference while writing.
3. Smart Story Elements Manager: Build a dedicated module for tracking characters, settings, objects, and lore. Allow users to store detailed notes, research, and descriptions for each element, creating a centralized story bible linked to their manuscript.
4. Plot & Story Boards: Implement a visual storyboard using a drag-and-drop "note card" interface. This should help users organize chapters and scenes, ensuring logical plot flow. 
5. AI Writing Assistance: Integrate an AI service (like OpenAI API) to offer auto-suggestions for story elements, generate character profiles, provide research summaries, and outline generation based on user inputs.
6. Advanced Manuscript Management: Create a smooth interface for organizing chapters and sections with drag-and-drop capability. The sidebar should offer quick access to footnotes, citations, comments, and writing goals.
7. Distraction-Free Environment: Offer a dedicated "focus mode" that minimizes sidebars and menus. Include a well-designed dark mode and typographic choices optimized for long reading/writing sessions.
Ensure local-first storage of manuscripts, support exporting to standard formats (.docx, .pdf, .md), and provide a simple setup command. Exclude advanced publishing/formatting tools for print, complex multi-user real-time collaboration, and subscription billing.
